days.title: Natural Wetlands and Forests
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: lecceta
stops.detail: 18 hectares of land are occupied by a holm oak forest, a residual witness of the "forest of Lecce", a wooded area that in the Middle Ages developed in an area between Lecce, the Adriatic coast, Otranto and Brindisi.

stops.name: bacino dell'Idume
stops.detail: In the spring season hoopoes and turtle doves station there, while sometimes during the winter, the presence of the swan has been recorded in the Idume basin.

days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: complesso masserizio di Rauccio
stops.detail: In the internal area, there are the masserie Barone Vecchio, dating back to the middle of the 16th century, and the Rauccio farm complex from the 17th century, consisting of the farmhouse, the Dovecote Tower and the Chapel, of which few traces remain.

stops.name: acquaterrario
stops.detail: The farmhouse, recently restored, houses the aqua-terrarium and is the headquarters of the WWF which carries out protection and enhancement activities of the park here.
